DayBuoy

DayBuoy privacy policy

Effective October 12, 2026. Operated by Jacob Carroll.

DayBuoy shows forecasts for Inlet Beach, Florida. It does not request GPS location, create an app account, show ads, or use advertising trackers.

On your device

The app stores recent forecasts, the last NWS surf report and preferences locally. The widget shares a short-lived forecast cache and subscription expiry with the app through an iOS App Group. Optional morning forecasts are scheduled locally, without a push-notification server. Removing the app clears its app storage; website storage can be cleared in browser settings.

Forecasts and hosting

The iPhone app includes its interface and ocean scene in the installed app. It requests a shared hourly forecast from the DayBuoy server. That server requests Apple WeatherKit (when configured), Open-Meteo Marine, NOAA and the National Weather Service using fixed beach coordinates, not your GPS position. The app and widget never contact weather providers directly. Forecast caches are temporary and replaced, not a history of your activity. The website is hosted separately and requires sign-in during private testing.

Network providers receive request information, including IP addresses, and may keep operational/security logs under their policies. See Open-Meteo terms, NOAA privacy and hosting provider privacy.

App diagnostics and updates

Native beta builds configured with Sentry send crash reports, error details, app/OS/device technical information and failed-feed events to diagnose defects. We do not intentionally attach names, email addresses, GPS location, local preferences, screenshots or recordings. Session replay, performance tracing, user-action breadcrumbs and advertising tracking are disabled. Native crash reports can include technical device identifiers and stack information. Providers receive network metadata. Retention follows the settings of the service account and provider policy.

Updates ship through TestFlight and the App Store; there is no over-the-air code updater. See Sentry privacy.

Purchases

Apple processes payments. RevenueCat validates purchase receipts and manages subscription entitlements using an anonymous app-user identifier, transaction information and technical device/network data. DayBuoy does not receive your card or banking information. Restore purchases is initiated by you. No email or app account is required. See RevenueCat privacy and Apple privacy.

Sharing and TestFlight

Sharing is initiated by you. Production app builds do not automatically upload screenshots, clips or performance-test results. Private development capture tools are separate. Apple may collect TestFlight diagnostics and feedback under its terms.

Contact

Use the DayBuoy support tracker for privacy questions; do not post sensitive information there. Material policy changes will update this page and its effective date.
